subject: general
question: Prakash starts from Point A and drives 37 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 40 km, turns left and drives 55 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 64 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 18 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Prakash starts from Point A and drives 37 km towards the north.

He then takes a left turn and drives 40 km.

He again takes a left turn and drives 55 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 64 km.

Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 18 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5285c0546af9645b3ed59472c66ffb735cb37318e30d7a1876c2a2ecf983849e.png] 

Therefore, the shortest distance is **24 km** and the direction is **West**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2 – 24 km to the West"**.
